prompt: # CODING AGENT PROMPT — BUILD "WORDS IN MOTION" LANDING PAGE (2010s Web Brutalism) **Role:** Act as a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build the complete, production-ready landing page described below in a single pass. Do not ask follow-up questions. Do not output partial work. --- ## 0. PROJECT BRIEF - **Theme:** WORDS IN MOTION — a kinetic typography stage. The product you are designing for is a web tool where designers choreograph animated, kinetic type and export it to the web. - **Style:** 2010s Web Brutalism — oversized uppercase type, exposed grid structure, hard 2px borders, hard offset shadows, raw mono labels — fused with modern glass (backdrop blur), translucent gradient blobs, and motion design. - **Keywords:** kinetic, type, stage, brutalism, animated, glass, translucent, gradient, blur. - **Mode:** Light mode is the hero mode and the default. **Exception clause:** although the source brief marks dark mode as optional, dark mode is mandatory in this build — it must be fully designed, tokenized, toggleable, and persisted (see Rule 1.3). - **Required visual effects:** Blur, Glass Effect, Gradients, 3D/Parallax, Hover Effects. - **Required CSS techniques:** Flexbox, Backdrop Filter, CSS Filters (`filter: blur()`), Keyframe Animations, Transitions, Transforms, Gradients, Border Radius. - **Section order:** Sticky Header → Hero → Features (3 cards) → How It Works (3 steps) → Testimonials → Pricing (3 tiers) → FAQ → Final CTA → Footer with secondary links. ### Token Mapping (define exactly, both modes) | Token | Light (default) | Dark | |---|---|---| | `--bg-primary` | `#F4F1EA` | `#141210` | | `--bg-secondary` | `#fefefe` (never `#ffffff`) | `#1E1B17` | | `--primary` | `#FF3B00` | `#FF4D1A` (brightened for AA contrast) | | `--secondary` | `#141210` | `#F4F1EA` | | `--text-primary` | `#141210` | `#F4F1EA` | | `--text-secondary` | `#57504A` | `#B3ABA1` | | `--text-success` | `#0E7A3C` | `#4ADE80` | | `--text-error` | `#C81E1E` | `#FF6B6B` | | `--border-default` | `#141210` | `#F4F1EA` | | `--border-error` / `--border-success` | derive from error/success tokens | derive from error/success tokens | **Verified contrast pairs (must hold in both modes):** ink `#141210` on paper `#F4F1EA` and inverse ≈ 15:1; ink `#141210` on `#FF3B00` ≈ 4.9:1 (AA, so primary buttons use dark text on orange — never white text on orange); dark-mode accent text uses `#FF4D1A` on `#141210` ≈ 5:1. Light backgrounds always pair with dark text and vice versa in every theme. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** - **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. - **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states are targeted via class or ID selectors in `style.css`. - **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML stays semantic and style-agnostic. Changing the site's look must require editing only `style.css`. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** - Store all tokens in `:root` and theme classes — colors per the table above, plus: - **Radius:** `--radius-sm: 0px` (brutalist default — sharp corners everywhere except glass panels), `--radius-md: 4px`, `--radius-lg: 20px` (glass panels only). - **Shadows (hard offset, no blur — brutalist signature):** `--shadow-sm: 3px 3px 0 var(--border-default)`, `--shadow-md: 6px 6px 0 var(--border-default)`. - **Spacing & Transitions:** `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`, `--transition-fast: 120ms`, `--transition-normal: 240ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`, plus `--ease-spring: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)` for kinetic entrances. - **Elevation:** `--z-dropdown: 100` (sticky header, mobile nav), `--z-modal: 200`, `--z-toast: 300`. - **Glass tokens:** `--glass-bg: rgba(254,254,254,0.55)` / dark `rgba(20,18,16,0.6)`; `--glass-border: rgba(20,18,16,0.65)` / dark `rgba(244,241,234,0.25)`; `--glass-blur: 14px`. - **Gradient tokens:** `--gradient-accent: linear-gradient(100deg, #FF3B00 0%, #FF9A3D 100%)` for highlighted display words (via `background-clip: text`) and CTA accents. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support** - **Implementation:** Define light tokens in `:root`, dark token overrides under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`, and `.theme-dark` / `.theme-light` classes that override both (class beats media query). This gives system-preference dark mode even without JS. - **Theme Switching:** Background and text variables must flip with zero HTML restructuring. Glass tokens must also flip. - **Persistence:** `script.js` reads `localStorage`; falls back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit; applies the class on load. The header must contain a visible toggle button with correct `aria-pressed` and a dynamic `aria-label` ("Switch to dark mode" / "Switch to light mode"), using Google Material sun/moon icons. **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment** - **Default Alignment Rule:** Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment (e.g., stretched card bodies). - **Mobile-Friendly First:** Mobile-first CSS; multi-column flex rows collapse to `flex-direction: column` on small viewports; fluid `clamp()` type scale (hero display up to ~`clamp(2.75rem, 9vw, 7.5rem)`); zero horizontal scrolling anywhere (marquee bands use `overflow: hidden`). **1.5 Framework Default** - No framework was requested. Use hand-authored CSS in `style.css`, organized in Tailwind-style cascade layers (`@layer tokens, base, layout, components, utilities`) with one consistent class system (see Section 4). No utility-class soup mixed with component classes. **1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)** - **Fonts (one Google Fonts `` in ``):** `Archivo Black` → `--font-display` (massive uppercase headlines, tight tracking); `Space Grotesk` → `--font-base` (body/UI); `Space Mono` → `--font-mono` (eyebrows, labels, prices meta, footer meta). - **Icons:** Google Material Symbols via Google Fonts link. **Raw inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden. No emoji as icons.** Social links in the footer are text links (mono, uppercase) — brand logos must not be hand-drawn as SVG. --- ## 2.
